title: HOSA Nutrition: Medical Nutrition Therapy - Nutrition - Medical Nutrition Therapy - Gallbladder
subject: Nutrition

questions.q: A patient is recovering from an acute cholecystitis (gallbladder inflammation) attack. Which macronutrient should be restricted to reduce stimulation of the gallbladder?
questions.explain: Fat intake stimulates the gallbladder to release bile. In cholecystitis, a low-fat diet helps minimize pain and stimulation.
